issues.proposed: Select on H DISCOVERY within each scribe; apply exact C/W unchanged to H and F CONFIRMATION. Holm over two scribes per reading; headline requires both readings in same scribe. This is an amendment to original alpha handling.
issues.resolution: RESOLVED BY USER-AUTHORIZED T3/AMENDMENT-1.json; frozen before discovery

Freeze minimal top-frequency 4..16 observed variants covering >=80%, require at least 4 observed types; ties lexicographic; ties in candidate score by presence, concentration, shorter window, lower start, class spelling. issues.issue: v4 G6 and G2 full-population gates NOT ESTIMABLE; no admissible final line labels. Wrap flag and reading/block registration map also need pinned inputs.
issues.proposed: Keep all label/text joins closed, including support that combines label with readable slots. Metadata-only geometry inventory allowed.

issues.issue: MH log rate ratio, folio weight and multiclass CMH-type statistic unspecified; support depends on permuted labels and unequal word-slot totals.
issues.proposed: Pin formula, zero-event handling, support recalculation vs fixed set, and weight definition before label joins; qualify requested within-folio unrestricted permutation against wrap/position nulls; no silent switch to wrap-restricted permutations.

issues.issue: Context-invariant confidence interval is not fully specified: max signed/absolute pairwise logRR, missing label pairs, simultaneous vs pointwise, sparse zero counts.
issues.proposed: Keep invariant classification unavailable until a simultaneous folio-bootstrap equivalence method and support rules are frozen; nonsignificance alone never yields invariance.

issues.issue: Two raters ordinal scores need a prespecified single response; averaging creates half-category outcomes. Model penalty grid, inner loss, convergence, and feature preprocessing not frozen.
issues.proposed: Freeze exact agreement-only primary cohort with nonagreeing pages excluded/listed; any adjudication requires separate blind protocol. Preprocessing inside training folds, identical scribe/layout baseline, shared held-out folios H/F.

issues.issue: Within-scribe outcome permutation breaks genuine ROOT/layout dependence. It tests exchangeability within scribe, not automatically the conditional added value over layout.
issues.proposed: Retain requested permutation and layout-only null. If qualification fails, report NOT QUALIFIED; changing to conditional simulation/permutation is a separately frozen attempt.

issues.issue: New ROOT pass requires different model families or human; existing Sonnet/Opus v4 roles are same family and do not supply ROOT ratings. Single-main-plant page eligibility must be blind and recorded.
issues.proposed: Prepare image-only eligibility/rating packet; no reuse of v4 context outputs as plant-part prominence; require valid rater route before collection.
